title: Chapter 95
text:
A helicopter landed on the helipad of Rose Militant's stronghold. Three men walked out of the helicopter. Their faces were cold, and they gave off an aura that kept people away. It was as if they were made from the same mold.

E 3, E 5, and E 9 were all assassins trained in the same training camp.

"What's the situation?" E 3 was the captain, so he went straight to the point.

Luo Qing explained the situation to him.

E 3 squinted his eyes and said, "The enemy is a sniper assassin. The ambush this time was a test. From the way he lured you, he must have gotten hold of detailed information about you. According to your information, he is heading to the stronghold of the Farian Group. However, the Farian Group is not to be trifled with. We cannot assassinate him there."

Luo Qing asked, "What do you plan to do?"

"The target of the assassin is you, so he wants to use you as bait. We will send people out as usual. He will definitely make a move. The three of us will ambush him and kill him."

Luo Qing immediately ordered, "Ghostfox, you will lead the team out for the next few days."

Ghostfox nodded.

…

In the stronghold of the Farian Group.

In the room, Han Xiao rubbed the stubble on his chin with his fingers. A cloud of doubt lingered in his heart.

The people of Rose Militant seem to be too weak …

Dorothy and the rest's performance made him feel strange. If Rose Militant was only at this level, there was no reason that the bounty had not been completed yet.

Han Technician's habit of being suspicious was triggered again. He felt that he had missed out on some crucial information, so he went to ask Antonio.

After knocking on Antonio's office door, Han Xiao peeked through the gap. Antonio was sitting behind his desk, going through some documents.

"Why are you looking for me?" Antonio asked with a smile.

Han Xiao sat opposite him and said, "I want to know more about the forces in the Somar Desert."

"Didn't I already give you the information? You already know their armed forces and the area of influence."

"I want to know about the things that are not written in the information." Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. "You know, the things behind the scenes."

Antonov lit up a cigar and laughed. "Looks like you've realized it. These armed groups are all tools. They all have money behind them to help them search for Felonia. If we can't eliminate the leader once and for all, there will be an endless supply of soldiers."

"For example, Gaton is backed by the Rothschild Family, who is also the one who issued your bounty. Hehe, don't be surprised. Rose Militant's bounty is public."

Han Xiao was not surprised. He muttered to himself. If this was the case, then to complete the mission, he had to eliminate all the members of the Rose Militant. He could not allow anyone to escape. Most importantly, he had to kill the leader, Luo Qing.

Antonio took a puff of his cigarette and said slowly, "The Rose Militant is backed by a political consortium in Ordina. They sponsor parties to manipulate politics and secretly operate mercenary training camps and assassin training camps. Their headquarters are in the Western Continent. They don't have much influence in the Southern Continent, but they are not something a small organization can compare to."

Han Xiao was enlightened. No wonder so many assassins from the Dark Net had returned empty-handed. It must be because the Rose Militant had sent reinforcements.

"What exactly is Felonia? How did it attract the attention of so many organizations?" Han Xiao had a feeling that this had something to do with his special reward.

Since there was an unknown number of reinforcements, the next step could not be reckless.

He had two plans. One was to wait for Rose Militant to take action. Two was to lure the enemy out of the stronghold. Both methods required Rose Militant to leave the stronghold. Rose Militant's reinforcements would have thought of this as well. There was a high possibility that they would let Rose Militant take the initiative to lure him out and then ambush him.

"What should I do? Maybe I can do the opposite?"

Han Xiao thought to himself. If he set up a trap at a certain location and then pretended to fall into the ambush and escape, he might be able to successfully reverse the ambush.

"I'll have to prepare more weapons this way."

…

Ghostly Fox led her team out for the third time. They wandered aimlessly in the desert. She was getting impatient and asked through the communicator, "Why hasn't the assassin appeared yet? Is he afraid?"

"Assassins are all very cautious. Since the last sneak attack was successful, he will wait for a while to observe your performance," E San said calmly through the communicator.

…

It was another night. Recently, Han Xiao had realized that he was always up to something at night.

He put the newly created items into the car and drove away from the stronghold to set up the traps.

The off-road vehicle drove out of the Fabian Organization's stronghold. The headlights of the car disappeared into the night. At the same time, it appeared in the lens of a telescope.

On a sand dune a kilometer away, E Jiu was wearing a yellow camouflage cloth. He watched the off-road vehicle with a pair of binoculars. A cold smile appeared on his face.

"The target left the stronghold in the middle of the night and is heading north. I think he is setting up a trap. He might have noticed our presence and is trying to use reverse psychology to lure us into his trap."

Since they knew that Han Xiao was in the Fabian Organization's territory, how could they not send someone to monitor his movements?

"This enemy is too inexperienced." E Jiu was calm. He felt that this mission would be very simple. Everything was under control.

…

At dawn, Han Xiao returned to the stronghold and looked for Antonio.

"You want me to help you drive?"

Antonov was surprised.

"Yes, I need to shoot, but I don't have hands to drive. So, I'm relying on you."

"Wait a minute. What does your mission have to do with me? Why do you want me to help you?" Antonio was puzzled.

"It's not easy for us to go on a trip. How can we stay at home? Let's go sightseeing and enjoy the scenery."

Antonio pointed at the endless desert outside the barbed wire fence. "Sightseeing?"

"Don't worry about these superficial things. Maybe you can see a mirage somewhere. There will be mountains and rivers. Although the desert is vast, it will work if you are sincere."

"I don't think we are close." Antonio's mouth twitched.

"I'll give you a chance to be friends with me." Han Xiao chuckled.

"… Has anyone ever told you that you are thick-skinned?"

Han Xiao touched his mask. Hmm, how can two layers not be thick?

Although Antonio looked fat, he hid a fierce fighting strength. Choosing him as the driver was purely because Antonio would not die so easily.

If he chose an ordinary person as the driver and accidentally got shot by a stray bullet, he would die from blood loss.

Antonio thought for a while and said, "If you let me participate in the mission, according to the rules, I have to get a share of the money."

"I'll give you 5%. What do you think?"

"Not good. That's too little." Antonio shook his head.

"Stop fooling around. You're just driving. Giving you 5% is good enough."

"If we encounter an enemy, the first one to be hit is the driver … at least give me 20%."

Han Xiao stared at him. "Why don't you rob someone?"

"Aren't I robbing someone now?" Antonio's small eyes flashed with shrewdness.

After arguing for a long time, Han Xiao finally got Antonio to agree to help by paying him 200,000 yuan. Immediate payment was more reliable than an unlimited amount of money. The nature of the mission also changed from a partnership to an employment contract. Hiring a driver at such a price and only using it once was simply too extravagant.

Antonio's fat body squeezed into the driver's seat with great difficulty. Han Xiao sat in the back and handed over the coordinate radar and explained the plan in detail.

After listening to the plan, Antonio grinned.

"Interesting."

…

Later, in the morning, the sun was scorching, and the desert air was distorted by the high temperature.

Ghostly Fox's team only sat in two cars. They were wandering in the desert, observing their surroundings.

"A car is coming!" a mercenary shouted.

In the distance, an armored off-road vehicle appeared on the sand dune and moved parallel to Ghostly Fox's team. It was Han Xiao and Antonio.

"The enemy is coming!" Ghostly Fox's face lit up.
